note: Mojang's April Fools builds. Every one of these is a real, officially released joke version - none of them is a mod or a fan remake. Two sources: the official version manifest (most of them are published there as type=snapshot, indistinguishable from a normal weekly snapshot) and the Betacraft archive (2.0, which Mojang never published metadata for). The launcher uses this list for two things: the dedicated 愚人节 filter on the download page, and to keep these builds out of the 正式版 / 测试版 / 远古版 filters so the normal lists stay clean.
